Course Creation & Management

PowerSchool Professional Learning

https://bit.ly/PSPLcreate

PART 1

Creating the Course

  1. 1

    Click the Professional Learning menu and then click the Build button on the left side of the screen.

  2. 2

    On the Build Courses and Sections screen, click the blue Build Course/Section button.

  3. 3

    Select Course Type (Instructor Led Course, Self Paced Course, or PLC) and then click the Continue button.

  4. 4

    Give your course a Course Title and choose the Office from the drop list. If you have access to more than one Office in PowerSchool Professional Learning, the Offices will be listed in alphabetical order. Finally, click the Create button.

    NOTE: The title must not be a generic title such as Faculty Meeting, Data Meeting, or In-Service Meeting. See the examples below for better alternatives.
    Faculty Meeting:
    • Innovative Teaching Strategies Workshop
    • Collaborative Curriculum Development Session
    • Student Engagement and Retention Training
    Data Meeting:
    • Data-Driven Decision Making Seminar
    • Advanced Analytics Workshop
    • Interpreting Educational Data for Improvement
    In-Service Meeting:
    • Professional Development Symposium for Beginning School Procedures
    • Effective Classroom Management Techniques
  5. 5

    Enter a Course Description.

  6. 6

    Choose the desired credit type and enter the number of units.

  7. 7

    Choose Delivery Time Frame, Method of Delivery, and indicate whether or not the training is data informed/data driven and research based.

  8. 8
    PLEASE NOTE: At this point, if you are an Office Administrator in the Office in which the course is being created, you can bypass approval of the course by clicking the "Bypass Course Approval" drop box and choosing "Yes". Otherwise, your course will need to be approved by a Final Approver.
  9. 9

    Choose ALSDE Default Survey for the Course Survey.

  10. 10

    Use the File Attachment feature to attach any desired documents to the course.

  11. 11

    When done with this part of the course form, click the blue Next button in the bottom right corner.

  12. 12

    Manage Course Alignment: On this screen, you can choose the appropriate Professional Learning or School Leadership standards. Be certain to click the drop box and choose the newer 2024 standards. Click Next.

  13. 13

    Now choose the appropriate Course Tags for your course (Subjects / Grade Levels) and click Next.

  14. 14

    Visibility: If desired, change the availability of your course by clicking the Manage Location button. This determines who will be able to find your course and register. If your course is available state wide, this screen should display AL. If you are creating your course at the School or District level, your school or district will be made available by default.

  15. 15

    Course Resources: Here you can add documents and resource hyperlinks by clicking the blue Add Resource button.

  16. 16

    Now you are ready to create sections for your course. Click the Add Section button.

  17. 17

    Section Creation — Section Details:

    • a

      Enter a Section Name and click the Add Section button.

    • b

      Notes: You can enter additional notes (including hyperlinks) in the Notes box.

    • c

      Contact Person: This is the person responsible for the training — please provide contact information such as an email address.

    • d

      Presenter: This is the person who will conduct the training.

    • e

      Delivery Format: Choose from the drop list.

    • f

      Instructors: To add Instructors who will manage the section roster (print sign-in sheets, mark attendance, and award credit), click the Add Instructors button. You can then search for and add Instructors. Always consider adding yourself as an Instructor — it makes it far easier to access section rosters later.

    • g

      Location Settings: You must add a location. If the section will be conducted online, indicate such.

    • h

      Registration Settings:

      • i.
        Enter the maximum number of participants.
      • ii.
        End of Registration Date. If you do not enter a date here, the section registration end date will default to the Start Date.
      • iii.
        Release to Catalog For Registration on: Choose the date and time at which the course/section will become active in the catalog for registration.
    • i

      Waitlist Settings: If desired, click the check box to allow for a Waitlist and enter a number for the maximum waitlist size.

  18. 18

    Section Creation — Class Times:

    • a

      Under the Class Time tab, make certain the toggle is set for "Populate start and end date based on class times". It should be in the green position.

    • b

      Click the Add Class Times button to add a start date and time. If the training takes place over multiple days, click Add Class Time again to add additional days.

  19. 19

    Now that you have the Section Details complete and Class Times set, click the Submit Course and Section button.

    At this point, if you were able to bypass approval, your course will be available for registration on the date/time you indicated. If you cannot bypass approval, a Final Approver in that Office will need to approve your course and section(s).

PART 2

Approving Courses

  1. 1

    Under the Professional Learning menu, click the Approvals button and choose My Pending Approvals. On this screen you will see any courses and sections waiting for approval — simply click the title to open one. (Pending items also appear on your Professional Learning Dashboard.)

  2. 2

    You will be taken to the Course or Section Details screen. Review all details of the course/section. When ready to approve or request revisions, click the Review Comments link in the upper right corner.

  3. 3

    In the Tier 1 Approval sub-window, click Approved and then click Submit.

    If the course/section needs revision, click Needs Revision and click Submit — you will be provided a text box to explain what revisions are needed. The original course creator will receive an email and will be able to go to Professional Learning > Build to revise and resubmit their course/section.
